offline.title: No internet connection
offline.message: This app needs an internet connection to show products, stock and orders. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your email and password to continue.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

setPassword.subtitleSet: Choose a password for your account — nobody else will know it.
setPassword.subtitleReset: Choose a new password for your account.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.invalidBody: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask the shop for a new one, or request one from the sign-in page.
setPassword.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open the full link exactly as it arrived in your email.
setPassword.successBody: You can now sign in with your email and your new password.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If that address belongs to an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. Check the spam folder too.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Money received and money still owed are never mixed together here.

today.title: Today
today.orders: {count, plural, =0 {No orders} one {1 order} other {# orders}}
today.owedOrders: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing outstanding} one {1 delivery order} other {# delivery orders}}

profit.label: Profit on today's sales
profit.help: Today's sales less what the stock cost and what the shop spent today. It counts every sale, including ones the delivery company hasn't paid for yet.

drawer.title: Cash drawer
drawer.subtitle: Where the end-of-day count is entered
drawer.staleDay: This drawer is still open from {date}. Count it before starting a new day.

openingFloat.label: Cash at open (this morning)
openingFloat.help: What was in the drawer when the day started — last night's remainder after any cash was taken out. It is a starting figure, not what is in there now.

expected.label: Expected in drawer now
expected.help: The morning float plus today's cash sales, less cash spent from the till. This is what should be there right now, before you count.

notClosed.title: Day not closed yet
notClosed.body: Count the drawer, record any cash you take out

notStarted.title: Day not started
notStarted.body: Last night left {amount} in the drawer. Open the day to start recording cash.

openDay.title: Open the drawer
openDay.description: The drawer starts with what was left in it last night: {amount}. Change it only if you put a different amount in.
openDay.notePlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this morning

closeDay.title: Close the day
closeDay.blindHint: Count the drawer first. What should be in it is hidden on purpose — you'll see it, and any difference, as soon as you save.
closeDay.withdrawnHint: What you are removing now. The rest stays in for tomorrow.
closeDay.noteRequiredHint: The count doesn't match. Write down what you think happened — it is saved either way.
closeDay.notePlaceholder: e.g. paid the driver from the till
closeDay.carryHint: Keeps the day on the follow-up list until someone works out what happened.
closeDay.saved: The day is closed and the count is saved.

closed.title: Day closed
closed.body: Counted {counted}. {carried} stays in the drawer for tomorrow.

cogs.label: Cost of goods sold
cogs.help: What the pieces you sold had cost the shop to buy — the price you paid, not the price you sold them for.

expenses.label: Operating expenses
expenses.help: Approved spending in this period — bills, salaries, supplies — plus what any stock you gave away had cost. Expenses still waiting for approval are not counted.

profitAll.label: Profit (all sales)
profitAll.help: Everything sold, less stock cost and expenses. It includes sales the delivery company hasn't paid you for yet.

profitReceived.label: Profit (received only)
profitReceived.help: The same sum counting only sales you have actually been paid for. Expenses come off in full, because a bill is owed either way.

margin.label: Profit margin
margin.help: Profit on all sales divided by what you sold — what the shop keeps out of every shekel that goes through it.

sold.label: Sold
sold.help: Everything that left the shop, after discounts and returns. It is not money in hand — part of it is still with the delivery company.

received.label: Received
received.help: The part of what you sold that has actually been paid for: counter sales, plus delivery orders the company has settled up for.

owed.label: Still owed to us
owed.help: What the delivery company is still holding for orders it has taken. Sold minus received — money on its way, not money you have.

search.placeholder: Search by order number, customer name or phone
search.label: Search orders

invalid.PERCENT: Enter a whole number between 0 and {max}.
invalid.AMOUNT: Enter a whole number, up to {max}.

empty.noOrdersDescription: Orders will appear here as soon as they're taken.
empty.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or filter.

detail.notFoundDescription: This order may have been deleted.

payment.title: Payment
payment.pendingExplainer: {amount} is still with the delivery company.
payment.nothingToCollect: This order is cancelled or returned, so there is nothing to collect.

statusActions.stockDeductionNotice: Starting preparation deducts these items from stock.
statusActions.confirmCancelWithStock: Cancel this order? The items go back into stock.

returns.title: Return
returns.description: Return the whole order, or set a quantity per item. Stock is restored either way.
returns.returnSelected: {count, plural, =0 {Return selected} one {Return # item} other {Return # items}}
returns.nothingLeft: Nothing left to return on this order.

manage.confirmDelete: Delete this order? It will be hidden from every screen.
manage.confirmDeleteWithStock: Delete this order? It will be hidden from every screen and the items go back into stock.
manage.noPermission: You can update the order status only. Cancelling, returning and deleting need a manager.

new.title: New WhatsApp order
new.subtitle: Write down an order that came in over WhatsApp.
new.needItems: Add at least one product before saving.

search.placeholder: Search products by name or SKU
search.label: Search products

lines.stockCap: {count, plural, one {That's the last one in stock} other {That's all # in stock}}

customer.title: Customer
customer.name: Customer name
customer.whatsappHint: Leave empty if it's the same as the phone number.
customer.locationHint: Paste the coordinates from WhatsApp into the latitude box and both fields fill in.

success.title: Order saved
success.nextStep: The order is New. Stock is deducted when preparation starts.

collection.title: Money with the delivery company
collection.subtitle: Orders you have not been paid for yet. Tick off what has come in.
collection.marked: {count, plural, one {Payment recorded for 1 order.} other {Payment recorded for # orders.}}

summary.label: Owed to you
summary.orders: {count, plural, =0 {No orders} one {1 order} other {# orders}}

empty.title: Nothing outstanding
empty.description: Every order has been paid for.

actions.selected: {count, plural, one {1 order selected} other {# orders selected}}
actions.markCollected: {count, plural, one {Payment received for 1} other {Payment received for #}}

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Sales and profit for the period you pick.

totals.title: Sales in this period

averageOrder.label: Average order
averageOrder.help: Sales divided by the number of orders — what a typical order in this period was worth.

discounts.label: Discounts
discounts.help: How much came off the full price in this period, counting both discounts on an item and discounts on a whole order.

cost.label: Cost of goods
cost.help: What the items sold in this period had cost the shop to buy.

profit.label: Gross profit
profit.help: Sales minus what those goods cost. Rent, salaries and other expenses are not taken off it.

totals.missingCost: {count} sold items have no cost price, so the profit shown is higher than the real one.

channels.title: By sales channel
channels.help: Where the sales came from: the shop counter, WhatsApp, or the website.

returns.title: Returns
returns.amountHelp: The value of what customers handed back in this period. The sales figures above already have it taken off.
returns.itemsHelp: How many items came back, and how many orders they came from.

empty.title: No sales in this period
empty.description: Try another period, or record your first order.

empty.noProductsDescription: Products you add will show up here.
empty.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or clear your filters.

detail.notFoundDescription: This product may have been removed.
detail.numberedPointsAlt: Product photo with its numbered points

delete.confirm: Delete this product? It disappears from the products list, the POS and the storefront. Past orders keep it.

form.employeeReadOnlyHint: You can add and reorder images below. To change the price or details, ask an admin or manager.
form.name: Name
form.priceReadOnlyHint: Only an admin or manager can change the price.
form.isActiveHint: Hidden products aren't shown in the store.

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.label: Barcode
barcode.parentSharedHint: One code for every variant? Put it here, on the product itself — scanning it at the till asks which variant sold.

generated.title: Our barcode
generated.hint: We generate it and print the label
generated.printHint: Print this piece's label from the Labels screen.
generated.pendingHint: A barcode is created as soon as you save.

supplier.title: Supplier's barcode
supplier.entryHint: Scan it with the camera or the counter scanner, or type it. No label is needed for this piece.

camera.title: Scan the barcode
camera.subtitle: Point the camera at the code printed on the piece.
camera.hint: Hold the code inside the frame.

fault.insecureContext: The camera needs a secure (https) connection.
fault.permission: Camera access was refused. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
fault.unavailable: No camera is available on this device.

partial.title: The product is saved. Its photos didn't all go through.
partial.detail: {count} photos are still waiting — this usually means the connection dropped.

variants.title: Variants
variants.noTypesYet: No option types yet — add one below.

images.variantFallbackHint: No images yet — the product's images are shown instead.
images.pendingHint: Photos will be uploaded when you save.

numberedShawl.title: Numbered points
numberedShawl.needsImage: Add a product photo above first, then come back here to place the numbers.
numberedShawl.placeHint: Tap the photo to add a numbered point. Drag a point to move it, or tap it to select and delete it.
numberedShawl.noPointsYet: No points placed yet — go to "Place points" and tap the photo.

kind.title: What are you selling?
kind.hint: Pick one — it changes what you fill in below.
kind.ordinaryDescription: One piece, or several in different colours and sizes.
kind.numberedDescription: One photo with numbers on it. Each number is its own piece with its own quantity.
kind.lockedByOptions: This product already has colours or sizes. Remove them all and save first — then you can change this. Nothing has been deleted.
kind.lockedByNumbers: This product already has numbers on its photo. Remove them all and save first — then you can change this. Nothing has been deleted.
kind.stockPerNumber: Each number keeps its own quantity, so there's nothing to set here.
kind.placeNumbersAfterSave: Save the product first. Then come back here to put the numbers on its photo.

form.trackLowStockHint: Off by default. Turn it on only for products you restock, so alerts aren't buried by one-off pieces.

needsApproval.price: A new price needs an admin's approval. Type it and save — it will be applied once approved.
needsApproval.stock: A new quantity needs an admin's approval. Type it and save — it will be applied once approved.
needsApproval.visibility: Hiding or showing a product needs an admin's approval.

awaitingApproval.title: Saved — some changes are waiting
awaitingApproval.detail: {count} of your changes need an admin's approval before they take effect. Nothing was lost.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Track stock quantities and low-stock alerts.
inventory.readOnlyHint: You can view inventory only. To change quantities, ask an admin or manager.

card.outsideFilter: No longer matches the current filter

empty.noItemsDescription: Products you add will show up here.
empty.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or clear your filters.

inventory.outsideFilterNotice: {count, plural, one {1 item no longer matches the filter — kept here so it doesn't vanish while you work} other {# items no longer match the filter — kept here so they don't vanish while you work}}

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.subtitle: Print labels for the pieces that still need one.

empty.allPrintedDescription: New products show up here until their labels have been printed.
empty.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search, category, or print state.

copies.simpleHint: One label per piece in stock.
copies.perVariantHint: One label per variant ({count}), from each variant's stock.
copies.numberedHint: Numbered shawl — one label for the whole product. Type how many you need.
copies.supplierBarcode: Supplier barcode — no label needed. Set a count to print one anyway.
copies.stockAboveMax: Stock is {stock}, and {max} labels is the most that can be set at once. Print the rest in a second batch.

preview.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} pages — all of them will print.

warnings.smallLabel: This label is narrower than {width} mm, so the barcode may be hard to scan. Print one and try it first.
warnings.gridOverflow: These labels don't fit on an A4 sheet with the current settings, so some will be cut off. Reduce the columns, rows, or margins in Settings.
warnings.tooManyLabels: That's more than {max} labels at once. Print them in smaller batches.
warnings.noLabels: Set how many copies to print for at least one label.

print.confirmDescription: If they came out right, we'll mark these products as printed. You can always print them again later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organize your products into nested categories.
categories.readOnlyHint: You can view categories only. To make changes, contact an admin or manager.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.description: Categories you add will show up here.

tree.pin: Pin {name} to the till's product browser
tree.unpin: Unpin {name} from the till's product browser

categories.favoritesHint: Star the ones your cashiers reach for most — they come first in the till's product browser.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store name, currency, stock levels, notifications, and barcode labels.

form.readOnlyHint: You can view settings only. Ask an admin to make changes.
form.currencyHint: Currency is fixed for now and can't be changed here yet.
form.defaultCountryCodeHint: Used to prefill new phone numbers.
form.lowStockThresholdHint: Products at or below this quantity are flagged as low stock.
form.saleNotificationsIntro: Every sale made by a manager or an employee sends a notification to the admins' phones. Nobody is notified of their own sale.
form.saleNotificationModeHint: More options are coming later, such as sales above a set amount or a periodic summary.
form.labelsIntro: How barcode labels come out of your printer. The Labels screen uses these numbers every time it prints.
form.labelPrintModeHintThermal: Each label prints on its own page, so the page is the label. Choose this for a label (roll) printer.
form.labelPrintModeHintA4Grid: Labels print in rows and columns on one A4 page. Fill in the sheet layout below so it matches your sticker paper.
form.labelSizeHint: Measure one sticker in millimetres. Between {min} and {max}.
form.labelSheetIntro: Measure your sticker sheet once, then these numbers are used for every print.
form.labelGridHint: How many stickers the sheet has across and down. Between {min} and {max}.
form.labelMarginsHint: The blank space between the edge of the paper and the first sticker. Type 0 if the stickers start right at the edge.
form.labelGapsHint: The gap between one sticker and the next. Type 0 if they touch each other.
form.labelSheetErrorHint: Some A4 sheet numbers aren't valid. Switch the printer type back to the A4 sheet to fix them.

notifications.title: Notifications on this device
notifications.intro: Turn notifications on to hear about sales on this phone as they happen. This setting applies to this device only.

state.on: Notifications are on for this device.
state.off: Notifications are off for this device.

blocked.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Try another browser or another phone.
blocked.needs-install: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to the Home Screen first: tap the share button, choose “Add to Home Screen”, then open the app from its icon and turn notifications on here.
blocked.not-configured: Notifications aren't set up on the server yet. Ask whoever runs the server.
blocked.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then try again.

notifications.failed: Couldn't change the notification setting. Please try again.
notifications.iosHint: iPhone and iPad note: notifications only arrive once the app has been added to the Home Screen and opened from its icon.

search.placeholder: Search by name, email, or phone…
search.label: Search staff

empty.noUsersDescription: Staff accounts you add will show up here.

form.name: Name
form.emailHint: Email can't be changed after the account is created.
form.passwordPlaceholderCreate: Leave blank so they choose their own
form.passwordPlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep current password
form.passwordHintEdit: Leave blank to keep the current password.
form.whatsappHint: Optional — used to reach this staff member on WhatsApp.
form.passwordHintCreate: Leave this blank (recommended): they get a link by email and choose their own password, so nobody else ever knows it.

passwordReset.sent: A set-password link has been emailed to {email}.
passwordReset.linkHint: If the email doesn't arrive, you can pass this link on yourself. It works only once.
passwordReset.inviteSent: A link to choose a password has been emailed to {email}.
passwordReset.pendingHint: This person hasn't chosen a password yet, so they can't sign in. Resend the link if it never arrived.

update.title: A new version is ready
update.description: Tap to get the newest version. It takes a moment, and nothing you have saved is lost.

changeRequests.title: Approvals
changeRequests.subtitle: Changes staff have asked for. Approve to apply them, or reject to discard them.
changeRequests.subtitleOwn: Changes you asked for. They take effect once an admin approves them.
